Starting a strength training routine can feel intimidating, but the fundamentals are simpler than most beginners expect.

## Start with the basics

A handful of compound movements — squats, hinges, pushes, and pulls — cover most of what a beginner needs before adding more specialized exercises.

## Progress slowly

Adding small amounts of weight or a few extra reps each week is enough to build strength steadily without risking injury from moving too fast.

## Recovery matters as much as training

Muscles adapt during rest, not during the workout itself, so beginners who skip recovery days often plateau faster than those who build rest into their schedule.

Consistency over months, not intensity in any single session, is what actually drives results for people just getting started with strength training.
